notes.title: DEMO RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 A New Era Begins 🔥[/h1][p]We’ve been listening… and we’re ready.[/p][p]Thanks to your amazing feedback and support, our game has undergone a complete transformation. [b]The name has changed. The theme has evolved.[/b] We’re diving deep into a [b]dark medieval fantasy world[/b]—one filled with mystery, danger, and legends waiting to be uncovered.[/p][h3]🛡️ [b]New name. New art. New identity.[/b]
Every corner of the game has been reimagined to bring you a richer, more immersive experience. From stunning new visuals to deeper lore, we’ve pushed forward because [i]you[/i] asked for more—and we heard you.[/h3][p]This isn’t just a game for us. It’s a game for [b]the community[/b].
We’re building this together—with passion, with purpose, and with your voice at the heart of it all.[/p][p]💥 And now, it’s time to show you what we’ve been working on.[/p][h3]🧪 [b]THE DEMO DROPS THIS FRIDAY – 12:00 PM GMT[/b] 🧪
Get ready to step into the world we’ve crafted for you.[/h3][p]Mark your calendars.
Sharpen your blades.
Darkness is coming.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45294894/c106070373113b317993705f2eb8753b4530d7e2.png"][/img][/p]
